metadata.title: Argentina Soybeans & Soy Products Supply & Demand
metadata.source: SAGyP (magyp.gob.ar), INDEC, Secretaría de Energía, Argus Media
data_notes: 100% Official Data from SAGyP (magyp.gob.ar), INDEC, Secretaría de Energía, and Argus Media.
Ending Stocks for month t equal Beginning Stocks reported on the 1st of month t+1.

Live SAGyP pull automatically updates Soybeans Crushed, SBM & SBO Production, Other Milling Use, Soybean Imports, Off-Farm Stocks, and Crushers Stocks (plus full Crushing Sub-Ledger) for new and future months as published.
Where INDEC Customs exports or Secretaría de Energía biodiesel figures are pending for the newest month(s), those cells and their dependent residuals display '--' (never estimated or interpolated).
